summary: Dyngjusandur sand sheet east-southeast of Askja caldera (~40 km long, 240 km2, 0.1-10 m thick). Three facies: SW deflationary basaltic sand with cobbles/boulders; Central inflating very fine basaltic sand with ripples, millimeter lamination, and cross-bedding (Stimson analog); NE pumice-rich depression fills from 1875 eruption (excluded contrast). Bulk basaltic sand oxide ranges: 48-52 wt% SiO2, 5-8 wt% MgO, 13-15 wt% Fe2O3.
